goal: Prevent inbound peers from bypassing inbound transaction-relay limits via BIP35 mempool requests
Stops peers with fRelay=false from obtaining mempool inventory without proper relay accounting
agreement: Neutral sentiment with previous objections addressed and no explicit approvals yet
Addressed concern that earlier change flooded unfiltered invs to fRelay=false peers (darosior)
Adopted suggestion to disallow mempool requests while transaction relay is disabled (gmaxwell)
Verified SPV client sequencing compatibility with bitcoinj maintainer (schildbach)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it fixes a circumvention of inbound transaction-relay capacity limits on NODE_BLOOM nodes
Closes an accounting loophole that allows inbound peers to consume relay resources without quota
